blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — About 2,000 city government employees, local officials, and supporters gave Vice President Sara Duterte a roaring, phone-waving welcome as she arrived at past 2 p.m. here on Tuesday, greeted by chants of “Duterte!”, “Duterte!” at the city gymnasium. Delegates from Malaybalay City, Don Carlos, and Pangantucan joined the local workforce to witness her arrival. Duterte served as the keynote speaker for the 18th founding anniversary and general membership assembly of the Valencia City Government Employees Union (VCGEU).
